p.i: A revelation given at Hiram, Ohio, 7 March 1832, through Joseph Smith Jr. to Stephen Burnett.

chapter.li: LEChapter80 Verse1 Truly thus says the Lord unto you my servant Stephen: Go all you, go into the world and preach the gospel to every creature that comes under the sound of your voice. VerseEnd Verse2 And inasmuch as you desire a companion, I will give unto you my servant Eden Smith. VerseEnd Verse3 Therefore, go and preach my gospel, whether to the north or to the south, to the east or to the west, it matters not, for you cannot go amiss. VerseEnd Verse4 Therefore, declare the things which you have heard, and truly believe, and know to be true. VerseEnd Verse5 Behold, this is the will of him who has called you, your Redeemer, even Jesus Christ, Amen. VerseEnd
